title: salix eriostachya var. lineariloba
intro: Salix eriostachya var. lineariloba, commonly known as Korean willow, is a plant species belonging to the Salicaceae family, characterized by its slender branches and narrow leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Korean willow are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Korean willow include salicin, a compound with analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
